index.hero_title:
We build products for the way the world moves.
Not one product. A company that makes them.
index.hero_desc: Parasite Notify designs, builds, and operates independent products across commerce, automotive intelligence, and software creation.
index.products_desc: Each product is built for a different problem, with its own team, design language, and roadmap — unified by how Parasite Notify approaches building things.
index.haco_desc: Buy from Chinese marketplaces and get it shipped home, without the language and logistics friction.
index.kalina_desc: Data and analysis for people deciding whether a used car is actually worth buying.
index.faro_desc: Turn an idea into working software, with AI handling the build so you can focus on the idea.
index.haco_showcase_desc: Send HACO a product link from any Chinese marketplace. It handles the order, the customs paperwork, and the shipping — and keeps you updated the whole way.
index.kalina_showcase_desc: KALINA reads market data, condition history, and pricing trends to tell you not just what a car is worth, but whether it's the right one to buy.
index.faro_showcase_desc: Describe what you want to build. FARO plans it, builds it, and lets you review and iterate — a real development process, not a chat window.
index.philosophy_desc: We don't build products to fit an existing category. We build the ones we think should exist, and we ship them ourselves — from the first line of code to the customer who uses it. Every product carries its own identity. What they share is how we make decisions: slowly on the things that matter, fast on everything else.
index.tech_desc: Not a stack we're proud of for its own sake — the parts that make it possible to ship products like these.
index.tech_01_desc: Powers KALINA's scoring and FARO's build process.
index.tech_02_desc: Market and pricing data pipelines that stay current.
index.tech_03_desc: Scales each product independently, on its own load.
index.tech_04_desc: Removes manual steps from order and build workflows.
index.tech_05_desc: Small teams, direct ownership, fast iteration.
index.tech_06_desc: Customer and payment data handled with care by design.
index.ecosystem_caption: PARASITE NOTIFY — parent to every product above
index.company_desc_1: Parasite Notify is a technology company that designs and operates its own products, rather than building for other companies. We start with a problem we think is worth solving properly, and we stay with it — from the first prototype through years of iteration.
index.company_desc_2: We're early. Our products are still growing, and we'd rather say that plainly than pretend otherwise.
index.company_desc_3: We work in small, focused teams that own their product end to end. Decisions about direction move slowly and carefully; decisions about implementation move fast. We'd rather ship something small and real than something large and imaginary.
index.contact_desc: Reach out about a product, a partnership, or working with us.
index.footer: An independent technology company building HACO, KALINA, and FARO.

haco.hero_desc: Send HACO a product link from any Chinese marketplace. We place the order, inspect it, clear customs, and ship it to your door.
haco.what_title: A buying agent that speaks the language you don't.
haco.what_desc: Chinese marketplaces have the products, not the access. HACO is the layer in between: it buys, inspects, consolidates, and ships — so you deal with one order, not five different systems.
haco.step_01_desc: Paste any product URL from a supported marketplace.
haco.step_02_desc: HACO places the order and pays the seller directly.
haco.step_03_desc: Your item is checked before it leaves the warehouse.
haco.step_04_desc: Consolidated shipping to your address, with tracking.
haco.features_title: Built around the parts that usually go wrong.
haco.feature_01_desc: Every item is photographed before shipping so you know what you're getting.
haco.feature_02_desc: Combine multiple purchases into a single shipment to cut cost.
haco.feature_03_desc: Every order stage is reported directly, no need to check in.
haco.feature_04_desc: Pay through the platform — never to a personal account.
haco.pricing_fee_desc: Per item purchased on your behalf
haco.faq_01_a: The major Chinese marketplaces — full list shown at checkout.
haco.faq_02_a: Typically 7–14 days depending on destination and consolidation.
haco.faq_03_q: What if an item arrives damaged?
haco.faq_03_a: Inspection photos are kept on file to support any claim.
haco.cta_desc: Create an account and place your first order in a few minutes.

kalina.hero_desc: KALINA reads pricing, condition, and market data to tell you whether a used car is actually worth buying — not just what it costs.
kalina.problem_title: Used car listings all look the same.
kalina.problem_col_1_desc: A price, a photo set, and a mileage number — no sense of whether that price is fair or that car is reliable.
kalina.problem_col_2_desc: Comparable market pricing, condition signals, and a straight answer on whether this specific car is worth the ask.
kalina.how_desc: KALINA combines three signals into one score, so the analysis is visible, not a black box.
kalina.factor_01_desc: Thousands of similar listings, tracked over time, set the fair-price range.
kalina.factor_02_desc: Photos, listing text, and history reports are read for risk signals.
kalina.factor_03_desc: Price, condition, and market position combined into a single 0–10 score.
kalina.pref_title: Weighted to what matters to you.
kalina.pref_desc: Prioritizing reliability over price, or willing to trade condition for a deal — KALINA's decision support adjusts to the trade-offs you actually care about, not a generic average.
kalina.cta_title: Paste a listing, get a score.
kalina.cta_desc: See the fair price range and Kalina Score before you commit to a viewing.

faro.hero_desc: Describe what you want to build. FARO plans it, writes it, and lets you review and iterate — a real development process, not a chat window.
faro.what_title: An AI product engineer, not an assistant.
faro.what_desc: FARO doesn't just answer questions about code — it plans the work, builds the software, and hands it back for you to review, change, and ship.
faro.step_01_desc: Explain the idea in plain language.
faro.step_02_desc: FARO plans and writes the software.
faro.step_03_desc: See exactly what changed and why.
faro.step_04_desc: Ask for changes in the same language.
faro.step_05_desc: Take the code with you, no lock-in.
faro.step_06_desc: Ship it directly from FARO when ready.
faro.cta_desc: FARO turns it into a working build you can review in minutes.
